ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

description.label: Form control for choosing two or more ordered values from one continuous range, with per-thumb keyboard, Angular Forms, and i18n support.

examples.note: Drag any thumb or click the track to move the nearest one. Thumbs never cross.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the range slider component.

props.note: Every input the range slider accepts, with types, values, and defaults.

scale.note: Static scale bounds mark the minimum and maximum of the track.
scale.scales-note: Log scales need explicit tickValues; zones recolor the fill from the first thumb.

thumbs.note: Two thumbs name themselves minimum and maximum; three or more use positional names. A minimum step gap keeps thumbs apart.

ticks.note: Tick marks are decorative (aria-hidden) and derive from showTicks plus tickStep.

types.note: Each format uses the display pipeline: temperature in degrees, and static scale bounds for the range.

vertical.note: Vertical fills bottom-to-top between the outermost thumbs. Keyboard is identical on both axes.
